newsitem.title: USA: Park-Ohio to acquire Arden Industrial.
newsitem.headline: Park-Ohio to acquire Arden Industrial.

text.p: Park-Ohio Industries Inc has agreed to acquire Arden Industrial Products Inc for about $42 million cash, or $6 a share, the companies said Tuesaday.

The merger pact, which has been approved by the boards of both companies, is subject to certain conditions, including satisfactory completion of Park-Ohio's diligence process and expiration of applicable waiting periods under federal antitrust law.
"The acquisition of Arden is a further commitment to our RB&W logistics business, which had sales of $151 million in 1996," Edward Crawford, chairman of Park-Ohio, said in a statement.
The transaction is expected to open new areas for Park-Ohio products and strengthen current operations, he said.
Arden is national distributor of specialty and standard fasteners to the industrial market. Its sales in fiscal 1996 were $87.5 million.
Park-Ohio is a diversified manufacturing and logistics company.
